lineage.parent_negative: P76 Native-only alignment failed frozen VAL 3/3; OOD ungenerated

question: Does explicitly preserving observed raw action identity alongside original frozen four-block native TTT projections restore factual key/query addressing, and does a FIT-only decoder make original-native TTT factual value vectors useful after that fix?

source.generator: Fresh independently seeded P76-family synthetic world generator: 16D per-world random orthogonal basis with eight target action keys, independent tanh target consequences, each target repeated twice and uniformly interleaved with 8 FIT/VAL or 32 OOD single-use normalized nuisance actions and random effects; one final executed simulated target action and withheld consequence. Keys and values only from executed historical facts; future query not used in historical writes. No OOD generation prior to qualification.
source.audit: FIT and VAL quarter-position max deviation <=0.05 and held-out index-only balanced accuracy <=0.55; queries' future effect 16-vector exactly zero; no target-role flags enter model; original model params byte-identical and three distinct initial core hashes.
source.source_provenance: No P65-P76 consumed cohorts reused; fresh authored RNG is not independently source-authenticated scientific first use.

arms.original_frozen: Original exact model.HybridPilot(32,16,Configuration(width=16, heads=2, ssm=true,attention=true,ttt=true,depth=true)) frozen random core per seed. Compute original causal stem, selective state recurrence, attention, TTT LayerNorm, projected factual TTT keys/query/values; no changes to native code or weights.
arms.native_only: Reuse P76 paired trainable 16x16 normalized projected-key and projected-query matrices (512 parameters), trained with only historical matching supervision and final query positive mask. Same original frozen native features as bypass; 512 params.
arms.raw_only: Matched 512-param key/query metric on normalized raw action keys, same training updates/minibatches, reference strong conventional raw full-history method.
arms.raw_bypass: Two 16x16 trainable native projection matrices as native_only + one sigmoid logit scalar (513 parameters). For history key and final query separately, L2-normalize weighted combination (1-alpha)*normalized(native@map)+(alpha)*normalized(raw_action). alpha shared between keys/query, learned on FIT. Init sigmoid(logit) near 0.20 (logit -1.3862943611). Same contrastive loss/VAL selection, no ground-truth effects or privileged relevance provided to forward() during historical writes.
arms.raw_exact: No-train raw-action nearest history matched against observed effects, strong conventional unbounded-history benchmark, must report 0-ish MSE and 100% matching.
arms.native_value_decoder: For each seed, train a closed-form FIT-only ridge (alpha=0.01, 16 projected native TTT value features plus bias to observed historical 16D consequences). Use the trained raw-bypass address index on VAL/OOD to select native value and map back to effect; separate from direct-value lookup. Original core/head is unchanged; this is a sidecar, not native full-model output.
arms.negative: Shuffle observed effects across history in independent P77 negative worlds, hold keys and final true effects fixed. After frozen FIT/VAL qualification require clean raw-bypass direct consequent prediction MSE much better than wrong credit.

training.init: Each arm seeded independent initial projection matrices but native-only and raw-bypass share byte-identical projection initialization per original model seed. Raw-only matched 512 initialized similarly.
training.checkpoint: Select lowest VAL contrastive loss only. After selection evaluate VAL matching and native decoded effects; do not use OOD for hyperparameters or threshold.
training.restore: Exact state_dict reload must produce bitwise equal logits on VAL subset. Original core hash must remain unchanged.
training.cost: Measure training wall time per arm, total experiment wall time, parameter count, full history required, native core state and FLOPs not equal with conventional raw method; no matched whole-process compute claim.

eligibility.before_ood: Every FIT/VAL audit PASS, raw exact VAL match>=0.99 and mse<=1e-5, all model and arm checkpoints finite, byte-identical native vs bypass initial matrices, model unchanged, cold restore PASS. Each of three bypass VAL match@1 >=0.90, bypass direct-value MSE <= 0.15*zero VAL MSE, and bypass native-value-decoded MSE <=0.75*zero VAL MSE. Native-only and raw-only reported, not eligible for tuning. If ANY fail STOP and OOD NOT GENERATE.
eligibility.ood: Fresh OOD DEV once. For all three seeds bypass raw-value MSE<=0.20*zero OOD, match@1>=0.85; bypass native-decoded-value MSE<=0.80*zero OOD; relative gain in bypass direct value MSE over paired native-only MSE >=20% with 2000 paired bootstrap worlds lower 95% improvement bound>0. Raw exact control must pass, no reuse.
eligibility.negative: Every model seed wrong-credit OOD MSE >=2x clean correct credit MSE (if clean 0, use denominator floor 1e-5); native original unchanged; cold restore and no query leak.
eligibility.status: Only DEV_PASS_IDENTITY_BYPASS_SIDE_CAR if all preregistered checks pass. If frozen failure, record DEV_FAIL and stop. Even pass proves only an externally supplied identity-preserving retrieval sidecar, not improvement to original TTT fast-weight state or original model output.
eligibility.science: No independent science claim: synthetic tasks, extra raw action observation/state, incompatible state/FLOPs to original and raw controls, no trained complete HybridPilot, no novel physical first-use. Full frozen scientific evaluation separately authorized and matched compute.
